summary.text: Ronnie Glynn is the Democratic state representative for Tennessee House District 67, part of Montgomery County, who lives in Clarksville, took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a business owner and retired U.S. Army master sergeant.

paragraphs.text: Glynn graduated from Halls High School and earned a B.S. in business administration from Trident University International in 2012.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1990 to 2014, retiring as a master sergeant after 23 years, and later worked as a military housing manager and small business owner.
He is a previous chair of the Montgomery County Democratic Party and has been affiliated with Big Brothers Big Sisters of America.
Glynn has been a member of the House since the 113th General Assembly.
Ballotpedia reports that he faces Chris Lanier in the general election.
